purpose: Replace repeated implementation-aggregate signatures with one author-signed scientific-surface lock and mechanically audited standing execution authority.
execution_only_repairs: request parameter serialization and provider request-envelope construction
credential environment injection without changing provider or route
HTTP transport handling within the frozen retry rule
deterministic parsing, schema validation, identity validation, and error classification
check-only, conformance, integrity, and sensitive-information audit implementation
mandatory_conformance_before_each_derive: baseline evidence selection and revalidation hashes match
model-visible packet bytes and hashes match
prompt and schema bytes and hashes match
three exact provider/model routes and route parameters match
normalized 72-request schedule, eight-call canary, and three repeats match
new implementation uses a new request domain and output path when prior version is terminal
prior raw responses and ledgers remain append-only and hash-bound
no valid model answer is requested again
no model-answer direction contributes to repair, rerun, or stopping decisions
no API credential is read and no endpoint is called before conformance passes and a derived authorization is materialized

automatic_resume_rules.pre_inference_provider_rejection: A request with mechanically proven zero valid model output may be reissued only under a new version/domain after an execution-only repair and passing conformance audit.
automatic_resume_rules.transport_failure: Only the frozen transport retry policy applies; outcome direction never authorizes retry.
automatic_resume_rules.preserved_http_200_raw_response: Reparse offline first; never call the model again merely because local parsing code failed.
automatic_resume_rules.valid_model_output: Terminal and never rerun, even if its decision is unfavorable.
automatic_resume_rules.partial_schedule: Carry forward every valid terminal record and execute only requests with no valid model answer.

requires_new_author_decision: any change to evidence pair, model-visible packets, prompt, schema, route, provider, model identity, parameters, request factorial, repeats, metrics, statistical analysis, exclusions, or stopping rule
any proposed rerun of a request that already has a valid model output
hash mismatch, append-only ledger violation, raw-response loss, or scientific-surface conformance failure
an execution failure that cannot be classified within the signed execution-only repair list
public release, repository visibility change, paper submission, or paper-facing effectiveness claim
terminal_boundary: This standing protocol does not authorize scientific-design drift, outcome-conditioned reruns, confirmatory use, public release, or submission. It remains valid only while every derived package passes the mandatory conformance audit.
